name: audit
description: Map the code, check each area on its own agent, then one report of what to fix

inputs.focus: bugs, security holes and missing error handling

map.title: Map the code
map.prompt: Map this repository for an audit of: ${{ inputs.focus }}. Split it into 3 to 12 areas that one reviewer can each read in under an hour (a module, a service, a group of routes). Don't change anything.

items.description: the area: its folder or files, and what it does

check.title: Check an area
check.prompt: Audit this area of the repository for ${{ inputs.focus }}: ${{ item }}. Read it closely. Report each problem with its file and line, why it matters, and the fix. Don't change anything.

report.title: Write the report
report.prompt: Here are an audit's findings, area by area: ${{ tasks.check.output }}. Merge duplicates, drop what isn't a real problem, and write one report: the problems by severity, each with its file, line and fix.

name: fix-failing-tests
description: Run the tests, fix each failure on its own agent, then run them all again

find.title: Run the tests
find.prompt: Run this project's tests and list each failing test with its error. Don't fix anything yet.

items.description: the test's name, its file, and its error

fix.title: Fix a failing test
fix.prompt: This test fails: ${{ item }}. Find the cause and fix the code (not the test, unless the test is wrong). Run that test to check it passes.

verify.title: Run every test
verify.prompt: Run all of this project's tests. Report what passes and what still fails, with the errors.

name: two-ways
description: Try a change two ways side by side, each in its own worktree, then pick the better one

try.title: Try it

approach: the cleanest change, even if bigger

try.prompt: Make this change: ${{ inputs.change }}. Take ${{ matrix.approach }}. Run the tests that cover it. End by saying what you changed and how you checked it.

pick.title: Pick the better one
pick.prompt: Two agents made this change: ${{ inputs.change }}. Here is what each did: ${{ tasks.try.output }}. Compare them on correctness, risk and size, and say which to keep and why.

name: explore-plan-build
description: Explore, write a plan, build it, then review the result

explore.title: Explore
explore.prompt: Explore this repository for this goal: ${{ inputs.goal }}. Find the code it touches, how it works now, and what could go wrong. Don't change anything.

plan.title: Plan
plan.prompt: Goal: ${{ inputs.goal }}. What exploring found: ${{ tasks.explore.output.text }}. Write a step-by-step plan: the files to change, the tests to add, and the risks.

build.title: Build
build.prompt: Goal: ${{ inputs.goal }}. Follow this plan: ${{ tasks.plan.output.text }}. Write the code and its tests, and run them.

review.title: Review
review.prompt: Review the change just made for this goal: ${{ inputs.goal }}. What the builder said: ${{ tasks.build.output.text }}. Read the diff, look for bugs and missed cases, and list what to fix.

name: migrate
description: Find every file a change touches, change each on its own agent, then check the build

find.title: Find the files
find.prompt: List every file this change has to touch: ${{ inputs.change }}. Don't change anything.

change.title: Change a file
change.prompt: Make this change in ${{ item }} only: ${{ inputs.change }}. Keep the file's style.

verify.title: Check the build
verify.prompt: The change "${{ inputs.change }}" was just made across many files. Build the project and run its tests; fix what the change broke, and report.
